title: Maria:
headline: A visitor seeing New York for the first time says she is happy, and her message is simple: be kind, it's free.
story: Nick asks Maria are you happy? She smiles and says yes: she is seeing places she has never seen, like New York, and her family is with her. She was just given $10 to help pay for a stranger's surgery. Will she use it? “Yeah, I would.”
Her message for the world is the ending: “be kind because it's free to be kind.” Light, warm, short. One person, one honest answer.
do: Open on frame 1 with Maria on camera and <q>Are you happy?</q> as top text.
Keep captions on the whole time. One text at a time.
Make the name super large. First name only: “Maria”.
End on her small smile and head tilt after “free to be kind”.
Blur the code on the card and the phone in the close-up.
dont: No title card or logo at 0:00.
Don't use the grandfather line (00:37–00:40) or “health care should be universal” (01:01–01:18). They belong to the compilation video.
Don't use C5088 00:14–00:41 (“you never know when you're gonna be the person…”). Compilation video.

bp_intro: Every source time below is in 20260922_C5089.MP4 (2:02, one camera). Times come from the transcript and are accurate to about 1 s. Find exact in and out points on the waveform. Every frame is from the real file. The yellow box shows the 9:16 crop.

rows.frame_alt: Maria smiling, beige coat, library steps behind
rows.visual: Maria in front of the steps, smiling as she answers. At 01:24 she is still looking down at her phone. Start on the first frame where she looks up. Crop centered on her face.
rows.motion: Nick's question on frame 1, top third: Are you happy? Lato Bold, white, soft shadow. Nick's voice plays under it. Cut his pause to under 1 s.

voice.quote: Are you happy? … Yes, I'm happy.

rows.sfx: Park ambience from the clip only.

rows.visual: Same shot. Short pause is fine.
rows.motion: Question text holds to 00:04, then out. Captions start.

rows.visual: Maria talks to Nick, off to the side of the lens. That is fine for a street interview.
rows.motion: Name super “Maria” at 00:05.5–00:07.5, lower left, above the captions, large.

voice.quote: Well, one, because I have the opportunity to visit places I've never seen before, like New York.

rows.music: Soft, warm bed can start here. 18–20 dB under her voice.

rows.visual: Same shot. Cut the 2-second pause before “And I'm also happy”. Hide it with a 105% punch-in.

voice.quote: And I'm also happy because I have my family with me and they're really important to me and they make me happy.

rows.frame_alt: Close-up of her hands with the card and a phone
rows.visual: The close-up of her hands with the white card and her phone (C5089 00:03–00:20). No sound from this part. It already fills a vertical frame well: crop around the card and phone. Blur the code on the card and anything readable on the phone.
rows.motion: Top text, one line: <q>She was just given $10 to help pay for a stranger's surgery.</q> Captions carry Nick's question underneath.

voice.quote: So do you think you'll use that $10 that you have to, like, help fund someone's surgery on there? … Yeah, I would.

rows.sfx: One soft phone tap, only if her thumb taps on screen.

rows.visual: Back on Maria. She thinks. Keep 1 second of her thinking.
rows.motion: Top text, same style as the hook: <q>One message for the world?</q>

voice.quote: And last question, if you had one message to share with the world, what would you want to say?

rows.visual: Maria says it straight. Hold on her small smile and head tilt to 01:59.
rows.motion: Captions only. Optional: color “kind” Watsi yellow #FFCC33, one time.

voice.quote: I would say be kind because it's free to be kind.

rows.music: Gentle lift. Resolve on the last “kind”.

rows.frame_alt: Maria tilts her head with a small smile
rows.visual: Live footage of her smile (C5089 01:58–02:00), not a freeze frame. Mute Nick's “Perfect, great message.”
rows.motion: End card on the footage, same as the other Watsi x AYH posts: <q>Support a patient</q> · <q>Link in bio</q> · <q>Watsi</q>. One line at a time.
rows.music: Last note rings out. 1 s fade.
